title: Searching for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity
summary: An agentic workflow searched UniProt for antimicrobial candidates in Streptococcus pseudopneumoniae and found a 97-amino-acid bacteriocin with no homologues among manually reviewed Swiss-Prot proteins. This is a computational candidate now undergoing laboratory validation; no potency or toxicity data are available.

evidence.tested: Nothing was tested in the lab: the candidate's novelty was checked by BLAST against Swiss-Prot, its predicted structure was compared with a known bacteriocin fold, and its genomic context was examined; the wet-lab plan is underway with no results.
evidence.unknown: No potency or toxicity results exist; the wet-lab assays outcomes are unknown; the session covered a narrow sequence window in one species.
evidence.ai_role: An agent queried databases, filtered candidates, ran BLAST and structure comparisons, analyzed genomic neighborhoods, synthesized literature and drafted a wet-lab plan under researcher direction.
